entrance: Sunken Night Elf ruins on the Zoram Strand, at /way 14.5 14.6. Swim through the pool at the bottom and follow the cave of the naga to the portal.

971.objective: Bring the Lorgalis Manuscript to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern.
971.note: The manuscript lies in an alcove of the room of Ghamoo-ra.

1198.objective: Find Argent Guard Thaelrid inside the dungeon.
1198.note: He waits in an alcove of the room of Ghamoo-ra and hands out Blackfathom Villainy.

1200.objective: Kill Twilight Lord Kelris and bring his head to Dawnwatcher Selgorm in Darnassus.

1275.objective: Collect 8 Corrupted Brain Stems from the satyrs and naga in and around the dungeon, Lady Sarevess included.
1275.note: The Corruption Abroad from Argos Nightwhisper in Stormwind leads to it, but that quest is optional.

1199.objective: Bring 10 Twilight Pendants to Argent Guard Manados.
1199.note: They drop from the Twilight's Hammer: Acolytes, Aquamancers, Elementalists, Loreseekers, Reavers and Shadowmages.

6564.objective: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost.
6564.note: A Blackfathom Tide Priestess outside the dungeon can drop the note.

6565.objective: Kill Lorgus Jett and report back to Je'neu Sancrea.
6565.note: He has no fixed spot and appears at one of several places in Moonshrine Sanctum.

6563.objective: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea.
6563.note: The crystals grow on the walls of the cave before the portal. The quest only opens after Trouble in the Deeps from Tsunaman at Sunrock Retreat.

6921.objective: Click the Fathom Stone underwater, kill Baron Aquanis and take the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea.
6921.note: After the Baron dies, every party member clicks the stone again for their own core.

6561.objective: Kill Twilight Lord Kelris and bring his head to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

6922.objective: Bring the Strange Water Globe, a drop from Baron Aquanis, to Je'neu Sancrea.
